title: Actor notes
description: GENERATED by `node tools/story/story.mjs build` (tools/story/actor-notes.mjs) from canon/world/*.md and data/npcs/*.json (D080): what each NPC's Actor sheet shows, keyed by the NPC's id. The `blurb` is one line from the NPC file's own role and affiliation. For a person whose file names a canon entity (`canon`), the entry also holds that person's settled facts (decided, accepted, provisional or proposal; never pencil, never cut), their open decisions, and a count of the pencil facts left out. The module's Actor sync (foundry/sync.mjs) reads it and core/actor-notes.mjs renders it into the sheet's blurb, public notes (the blurb only) and private notes (GM only). `story check` fails when it is out of date; never edit it by hand.

npcs.description: NPC id (the file name in data/npcs/) to what its Actor sheet shows.

blurb.description: One line under the Actor's name, built from the NPC file's role and affiliation. Empty when the file has no role. It is also the Actor's public notes: nothing from canon is ever written there.

canon.description: The NPC file's `canon` link: a canon entity id, or entity.slug for one person inside a group entity (night-regulars, directorate-posts). Absent when the NPC has no canon entity.

settled.description: The person's decided, accepted, provisional and proposed facts, in the order the table meets them.

open.description: The person's open decisions, to be flagged 'not decided yet'.

sketched.description: How many pencil (sketch) facts canon holds about the person. Counted, never listed: play material does not cite pencil.

known.description: Who in the world knows it.

told.description: When the table hears it, as canon writes it: start, later, or in:<scene or chapter id>.

toldAt.description: Where, for people to read: the scene's title, 'Chapter 2', 'the start' or 'later'.

heldBack.description: True when the table is not told it at the start or in a scene of the plan (a later chapter, or not scheduled): the sheet lists it under 'Held back (GM only)'.

heldBy.description: For a belief rather than a fact: who holds it.

true.description: For a belief: whether it is true.

text.description: The open fact's words: the question Ingram still has to answer.
